lede: Cincinnati Bengals carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play), while Miami Dolphins owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#25 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Miami Dolphins +2.4 with a fair total of 47.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Cincinnati Bengals pass offence vs Miami Dolphins pass defence, which sits +0.138 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
